`split(';')` breaks when SQL string literals contain semicolons\n315\t/// (e.g., `INSERT INTO t(v) VALUES('a;b')`). This function uses a small state\n316\t/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n317\t/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n318\t/// - A double-quoted identifier (`\"...\"`, with `\"\"` as escape)\n319\t/// - A line comment (`-- ...`)\n320\t/// - A block comment (`/* ... */`)\n321\t///\n322\t/// Only semicolons at the top level (outside all of the above) are treated as\n323\t/// statement terminators.\n324\tfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n325\t    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n326\t    let len = bytes.len();\n327\t    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n328\t    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n329\t    let mut i = 0;\n330\t\n331\t    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n332\t    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n333\t    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n334\t    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n335\t    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n336\t\n337\t    while i < len {\n338\t        let b = bytes[i];\n339\t\n340\t        // --- Line comment state ---\n341\t        if in_line_comment {\n342\t            if b == b'\\n' {\n343\t                in_line_comment = false;\n344\t            }\n345\t            i += 1;\n346\t            continue;\n347\t        }\n348\t\n349\t        // --- Block comment state ---\n350\t        if in_block_comment {\n351\t            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n352\t                in_block_comment = false;\n353\t                i += 2;\n354\t            } else {\n355\t                i += 1;\n356\t            }\n357\t            continue;\n358\t        }\n359\t\n360\t        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n361\t        if in_single_quote {\n362\t            if b == b'\\'' {\n363\t                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n364\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n365\t                    i += 2;\n366\t                } else {\n367\t                    in_single_quote = false;\n368\t                    i += 1;\n369\t                }\n370\t            } else {\n371\t                i += 1;\n372\t            }\n373\t            continue;\n374\t        }\n375\t\n376\t        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n377\t        if in_double_quote {\n378\t            if b == b'\"' {\n379\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n380\t                    i += 2;\n381\t                } else {\n382\t                    in_double_quote = false;\n383\t                    i += 1;\n384\t                }\n385\t            } else {\n386\t                i += 1;\n387\t            }\n388\t            continue;\n389\t        }\n390\t\n391\t        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n392\t        if b == b'\\'' {\n393\t            in_single_quote = true;\n394\t            i += 1;\n395\t        } else if b == b'\"' {\n396\t            in_double_quote = true;\n397\t            i += 1;\n398\t        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n399\t            in_line_comment = true;\n400\t            i += 2;\n401\t        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n402\t            in_block_comment = true;\n403\t            i += 2;\n404\t        } else if b == b';' {\n405\t            // Statement terminator at top level.\n406\t            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n407\t            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n408\t                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n409\t            }\n410\t            start = i + 1;\n411\t            i += 1;\n412\t        } else {\n413\t            i += 1;\n414\t        }\n415\t    }\n416\t\n417\t    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n418\t    if start < len {\n419\t        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n420\t        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n421\t            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n422\t        }\n423\t    }\n424\t\n425\t    stmts\n426\t}\n427\t\n428\t/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\n429\tfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n430\t    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n431\t    Ok(())\n432\t}\n433\t\n434\tpub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n435\t    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n436\t    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n437\t    Ok(())\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t/// Apply database migrations for schema changes.\n441\t/// This handles adding new columns to existing tables.\n442\tfn apply_migrations(conn: &Connection) -> )?;\n512\t        conn.execute(\n513\t            \"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN duration_seconds INTEGER\",\n514\t            [],\n515\t        )?;\n516\t    }\n517\t\n518\t    Ok(())\n519\t}\n520\t\n521\tpub fn ensure_wal_mode(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n522\t    // Use execute_batch so PRAGMAs that return rows don't cause errors\n523\t identifiers, and comments.\n///\n/// A naive `split(';')` breaks when SQL string literals contain semicolons\n/// (e.g., `INSERT INTO t(v) VALUES('a;b')`). This function uses a small state\n/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n/// - A double-quoted identifier (`\"...\"`, with `\"\"` as escape)\n/// - A line comment (`-- ...`)\n/// - A block comment (`/* ... */`)\n///\n/// Only semicolons at the top level (outside all of the above) are treated as\n/// statement terminators.\nfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n    let len = bytes.len();\n    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n    let mut i = 0;\n\n    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n\n    while i < len {\n        let b = bytes[i];\n\n        // --- Line comment state ---\n        if in_line_comment {\n            if b == b'\\n' {\n                in_line_comment = false;\n            }\n            i += 1;\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Block comment state ---\n        if in_block_comment {\n            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n                in_block_comment = false;\n                i += 2;\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n        if in_single_quote {\n            if b == b'\\'' {\n                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_single_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n        if in_double_quote {\n            if b == b'\"' {\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_double_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n        if b == b'\\'' {\n            in_single_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'\"' {\n            in_double_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n            in_line_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n            in_block_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b';' {\n            // Statement terminator at top level.\n            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n            }\n            start = i + 1;\n            i += 1;\n        } else {\n            i += 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n    if start < len {\n        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n        }\n    }\n\n    stmts\n}\n\n/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\nfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Apply database migrations for schema changes.\n/// This handles adding new columns to existing tables.\nfn apply_migrations(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    // Migration 1: Update critical_path_cache schema if it has the old format\n    // Old format: bead_id, float (REAL), updated_at\n    // New format: bead_id, epic_id, es (INTEGER), ls (INTEGER), float (INTEGER), updated_at\n    let has_es: bool = conn\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('critical_path_cache') WHERE name='es'\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n        )\n        .unwrap_or(false);\n\n    if !has_es {\n        // Table has old schema - recreate with new schema\n        conn.execute_batch(\n            \"BEGIN;\n             CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS critical_path_cache_new (\n                 bead_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                 epic_id     TEXT,\n                 es          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 ls          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 float       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 updated_at  DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n                 FOREIGN KEY (bead_id) REFERENCES issues(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n             );\n             INSERT INTO critical_path_cache_new (bead_id, float, updated_at)\n                 SELECT bead_id, CAST(float AS INTEGER), updated_at FROM critical_path_cache;\n             DROP TABLE critical_path_cache;\n             ALTER TABLE critical_path_cache_new RENAME TO critical_path_cache;\n             COMMIT;\",\n        )?;\n    }\n\n    // Create indexes for critical_path_cache (idempotent)\n    let _ = conn.execute_batch(\n        \"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_epic ON critical_path_cache(epic_id);\n         CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_float ON critical_path_cache(float);\",\n    );\n\n    // Migration 2: Add workspace_path to worker_sessions if missing\n    // Older databases may not have this column; br never reads worker_sessions so this is safe.\n    let has_workspace_path: bool = conn\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('worker_sessions') WHERE     \"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN workspace_path TEXT\",\n            [],\n        )?;\n    }\n\n    // Migration 3: Add closed_at and duration_seconds to worker_sessions for velocity tracking\n    let has_closed_at: bool = conn\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('worker_sessions') WHERE name='closed_at'\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n        )\n        .unwrap_or(false);\n\n    if !has_closed_at {\n        conn.execute(\n            \"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN closed_at DATETIME\",\n            [],\n        )?;\n        conn.execute(\n            \"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN duration_seconds INTEGER\",\n            [],\n        )?;\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn ensure_wal_mode(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    // Use execute_batch so PRAGMAs that return rows don't cause errors\n    conn.execute_batch(\n        \"PRAGMA    .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n750\t                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n751\t                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n752\t                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n753\t                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n754\t        });\n755\t        let mut other_comments = other.comments.clone();\n756\t        other_comments.sort_by(|left, right| {\n757\t            left.issue_id\n758\t                .cmp(&right.issue_id)\n759\t                .then_with(|| left.created_at.cmp(&right.created_at))\n760\t                .then_with(|| left.author.cmp(&right.author))\n761\t                .then_with(|| left.body.cmp(&right.body))\n762\t                .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))\n763\t        });\n764\t        if self_comments != other_comments {\n765\t            return false;\n766\t        }\n767\t\n768\t        true\n769\t    }\n770\t\n771\t    /// Check if this issue is a tombstone that has exceeded its TTL.\n772\t    #[must_use]\n773\t    pub fn is_expired_tombstone(&self, retention_days: Option<u64>) -> bool {\n774\t        if self.status != Status::Tombstone {\n775\t            return false;\n776\t        }\n777\t\n778\t        let Some(days) = retention_days else {\n779\t            return false;\n780\t        };\n781\t\n782\t        if days == 0 {\n783\t            return false;\n784\t        }\n785\t\n786\t        let Some(deleted_at) = self.deleted_at else {\n787\t            return false;\n788\t        };\n789\t\n790\t        // Clamp days to a safe maximum to avoid panic in Duration::days().\n791\t        let max_safe_days = 365_u64 * 1000;\n792\t        let days_i64 = i64::try_from(days.min(max_safe_days)).unwrap_or(365_000);\n793\t        let expiration_time = deleted_at + chrono::Duration::days(days_i64);\n794\t        Utc::now() > expiration_time\n795\t    }\n796\t}\n797\t\n798\t/// Epic completion status with child is_expired_tombstone(&self, retention_days: Option<u64>) -> bool {\n        if self.status != Status::Tombstone {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(days) = retention_days else {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        if days == 0 {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        let Some(deleted_at) = self.deleted_at else {\n            return false;\n        };\n\n        // Clamp days to a safe maximum to avoid panic in Duration::days().\n        let max_safe_days = 365_u64 * 1000;\n        let days_i64 = i64::try_from(days.min(max_safe_days)).unwrap_or(365_000);\n        let expiration_time = deleted_at + chrono::Duration::days(days_i64);\n        Utc::now() > expiration_time\n    }\n}\n\n/// Epic completion status with child counts.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct EpicStatus {\n    pub epic: Issue,\n    pub total_children: usize,\n    pub closed_children: usize,\n    pub eligible_for_close: bool,\n}\n\n/// Relationship between two issues.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Dependency {\n    /// \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub created_by: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Optional metadata (JSON).\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub metadata: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Thread ID for conversation linking.\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub thread_id: Option<String>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for Dependency {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            issue_id: String::new(),\n            depends_on_id: String::new(),\n            dep_type: DependencyType::Blocks,\n            created_at: Utc::now(),\n            created_by: None,\n            metadata: None,\n            thread_id: None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// A comment on an issue.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub the issue's history (audit log).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Event {\n    pub id: i64,\n    pub issue_id: String,\n    #[serde(rename = \"type\")]\n    pub event_type: EventType,\n    pub actor: String,\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub old_value: Option<String>,\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub new_value: Option<String>,\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub comment: Option<String>,\n    pub created_at: This function uses a small state\n316\t/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n317\t/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n318\t/// - A (outside all of the above) are treated as\n323\t/// statement terminators.\n324\tfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n325\t    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n326\t    let len = bytes.len();\n327\t    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n328\t    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n329\t    let mut i = 0;\n330\t\n331\t    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n332\t    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n333\t    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n334\t    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n335\t    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n336\t\n337\t    while i < len {\n338\t        let b = bytes[i];\n339\t\n340\t        // --- Line comment state ---\n341\t        if in_line_comment {\n342\t            if b == b'\\n' {\n343\t                in_line_comment = false;\n344\t            }\n345\t            i += 1;\n346\t            continue;\n347\t        }\n348\t\n349\t        // --- Block comment state ---\n350\t        if in_block_comment {\n351\t            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n352\t                in_block_comment = false;\n353\t                i += 2;\n354\t            } else {\n355\t                i += 1;\n356\t            }\n357\t            continue;\n358\t        }\n359\t\n360\t        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n361\t        if in_single_quote {\n362\t            if b == b'\\'' {\n363\t                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n364\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n365\t                    i += 2;\n366\t                } else {\n367\t                    in_single_quote = false;\n368\t                    i += 1;\n369\t                }\n370\t            } else {\n371\t                i += 1;\n372\t            }\n373\t            continue;\n374\t        }\n375\t\n376\t        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n377\t        if in_double_quote {\n378\t            if b == b'\"' {\n379\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n380\t                    i += 2;\n381\t                } else {\n382\t                    in_double_quote = false;\n383\t                    i += 1;\n384\t                }\n385\t            } else {\n386\t                i += 1;\n387\t            }\n388\t            continue;\n389\t        }\n390\t\n391\t        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n392\t        if b == b'\\'' {\n393\t            in_single_quote = true;\n394\t            i += 1;\n395\t        } else if b == b'\"' {\n396\t            in_double_quote = true;\n397\t            i += 1;\n398\t        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n399\t            in_line_comment = true;\n400\t            i += 2;\n401\t        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n402\t            in_block_comment = true;\n403\t            i += 2;\n404\t        } else if b == b';' {\n405\t            // Statement terminator at top level.\n406\t            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n407\t            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n408\t                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n409\t            }\n410\t            start = i + 1;\n411\t            i += 1;\n412\t        } else {\n413\t            i += 1;\n414\t        }\n415\t    }\n416\t\n417\t    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n418\t    if start < len {\n419\t        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n420\t        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n421\t            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n422\t        }\n423\t    }\n424\t\n425\t    stmts\n426\t}\n427\t\n428\t/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\n429\tfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n430\t    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n431\t    Ok(())\n432\t}\n433\t\n434\tpub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n435\t    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n436\t    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n437\t    Ok(())\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t/// Apply database migrations for schema changes.\n441\t/// This handles adding new columns to existing tables.\n442\tfn apply_migrations(conn: &Connection) ->
